create.name: Dr. Carmen Acevedo Butcher
create.bio:
Carmen Acevedo Butcher is an American translator, scholar and poet who brings the writings of Christian mystics into fresh, inclusive modern English. After a doctorate on medieval texts from the University of Georgia and a Fulbright year in London, she works from Old and Middle English, Latin, German and early modern French. Her translations include the anonymous Cloud of Unknowing and the Practice of the Presence of Brother Lawrence, alongside readers on Hildegard of Bingen and the women mystics, and the sermons of the Anglo-Saxon monk Ælfric. She treats language itself as part of the practice, loosening rigid and exclusive phrasing so that present-day readers can meet these old texts directly.

Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, she teaches writing at the University of California, Berkeley, where her teaching has won several awards. Beyond the university she gives talks and workshops for churches and spiritual directors on contemplative prayer, unknowing and simplicity, and she was interviewed by James Finley for The Shift Network's Mystics Summit. Her YouTube channel gathers readings from her translations and essays, short guided practices such as lectio divina and the welcoming prayer, and chants she sings herself.

books.title: Practice of the Presence: A Revolutionary Translation
books.author: Brother Lawrence, translated by Carmen Acevedo Butcher
books.description: A new English version of the letters and conversations of Brother Lawrence, the seventeenth-century Carmelite lay brother who found God among the pots and pans of a monastery kitchen. The translation uses inclusive language and stays close to the plain voice of the French.

books.title: The Cloud of Unknowing (Shambhala Pocket Library)
books.author: Anonymous, translated by Carmen Acevedo Butcher
books.description: Her readable modern rendering of the fourteenth-century English guide to contemplative prayer, which teaches the reader to rest in love beyond concepts. This edition is the small-format Shambhala Pocket Library version.

books.title: Incandescence: 365 Readings with Women Mystics
books.author: Carmen Acevedo Butcher
books.description: A year of daily readings in her own translations from women mystics, known and lesser known, gathered as short meditations, prayers, poems and songs.

books.title: A Little Daily Wisdom: Christian Women Mystics
books.author: Carmen Acevedo Butcher
books.description: A compact book of daily readings drawn from the medieval women mystics, meant to make a few quiet minutes for prayer in a busy day.

books.title: Man of Blessing: A Life of St. Benedict
books.author: Carmen Acevedo Butcher
books.description: A biography of Benedict of Nursia that weaves the early legends together with the history of late Roman Italy, including his bond with his twin sister Scholastica and the roots of monastic simplicity.

books.title: God of Mercy: Ælfric's Sermons and Theology
books.author: Carmen Acevedo Butcher
books.description: Seventeen Old English sermons by the tenth-century Benedictine Ælfric of Eynsham, translated into modern English for the first time, with an introduction to his life and thought.

books.title: Following Christ: A Lenten Reader to Stretch Your Soul
books.author: Carmen Acevedo Butcher
books.description: Prayers, poems and meditations from the desert mothers and fathers, the medieval mystics and others, arranged by theme across the season of Lent.
